```{r}

data_syntax <- read_csv("../data/NG3_Data.csv") 

data_packing <- data_syntax %>% filter(!is.na(packing_coding))


```


```{r}
data_syntax %>%
  distinct(
    language, condition,
    ETvsC, TvsE,
    c_train, c_small_large, c_both_vs_others
  ) %>%
  arrange(language, condition) %>%
  print(n = Inf)


```


# syntax alignment

## descriptives
```{r}
# 1. By language
subj_level_language <- data_syntax %>%
  group_by(cond_subj, language) %>%
  summarise(
    accuracy = mean(syntax_only, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(language) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_full = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_full = sd(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

subj_level_language


# 2. Any training vs no training
subj_level_training_all <- data_syntax %>%
  mutate(training_all = ifelse(condition == "no", 0, 1)) %>%
  group_by(cond_subj, training_all) %>%
  summarise(
    accuracy = mean(syntax_only, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(training_all) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_full = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_full = sd(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

subj_level_training_all


# 3. Small training: yes vs no
subj_level_training_small <- data_syntax %>%
  group_by(cond_subj, training_small) %>%
  summarise(
    accuracy = mean(syntax_only, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(training_small) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_full = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_full = sd(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

subj_level_training_small





# 4. Small vs large
subj_level_small <- data_syntax %>% filter(condition != "no" &condition != "both" ) %>% 
  group_by(cond_subj, condition) %>%
  summarise(
    accuracy = mean(syntax_only, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_full = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_full = sd(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

subj_level_small



# 5. number of training
subj_level_number <- data_syntax %>% filter(condition != "no") %>% 
  mutate(training_number = ifelse(condition == "both", 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(cond_subj, training_number) %>%
  summarise(
    accuracy = mean(syntax_only, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(training_number) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_full = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_full = sd(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

subj_level_number

```


## plot

```{r CI contour}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)


exp3_syntax <- data_syntax %>%
  mutate(
    language = factor(
      tools::toTitleCase(language),
      levels = c("Chinese", "English", "Turkish")
    ),
    condition = factor(
      condition,
      levels = c("no", "small", "large", "both"),
      labels = c("No", "Small", "Large", "Both")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(cond_subj, language, condition) %>%
  summarise(
    acc = mean(syntax_only, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = acc)) +
  stat_summary(
  aes(group = 1),
  fun.data = mean_cl_normal,
  geom = "ribbon",
  alpha = 0.20,
  fill = "gray35"
) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1))+
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = 1),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    linewidth = 1,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 21,
    size = 2.8,
    stroke = 0.8,
    color = "black",
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Mean score"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ language, ncol = 3) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
theme(
  panel.grid = element_blank(),
  axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
  axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
  legend.position = "none"
)+labs(
  x = "Condition",
  y = "Percentage of syntactically correct responses"
)

exp3_syntax
```


## model

```{r}



syntax <- glmer(syntax_only~ (ETvsC + TvsE)*(c_train +c_small_large+c_both_vs_others)  +(1|cond_subj)+ (1|trial), data=data_syntax,family="binomial",control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"))

summary(syntax)




# including math background
syntax <- glmer(syntax_only~ (ETvsC + TvsE)*(c_train +c_small_large+c_both_vs_others) + math_z +(1|cond_subj)+ (1|trial), data=data_syntax,family="binomial",control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"))

summary(syntax)

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

scores <- bind_rows(
  data_syntax %>%
    transmute(cond_subj, language, condition,
              measure = "Syntax", acc = syntax_only),
  data_packing %>%  # Syntactically correct trials only
    transmute(cond_subj, language, condition,
              measure = "Packing | Correct syntax", acc = packing_coding)
) %>%
  mutate(
    language = factor(
      tools::toTitleCase(as.character(language)),
      levels = c("Chinese", "English", "Turkish")
    ),
    training = factor(
      if_else(tolower(as.character(condition)) == "no",
              "No training", "Any training"),
      levels = c("No training", "Any training")
    ),
    measure = factor(
      measure, levels = c("Syntax", "Packing | Correct syntax")
    ),
    acc = as.numeric(as.character(acc))
  )

plot_effect <- function(effect, x_label, tag) {
  participants <- scores %>%
    group_by_at(unique(c("cond_subj", "language", effect, "measure"))) %>%
    summarise(acc = mean(acc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(is.finite(acc))

  ggplot(participants, aes(.data[[effect]], acc, fill = measure)) +
    stat_summary(
      fun = mean, geom = "col",
      width = 0.65, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = measure),
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0.015, seed = 123),
      size = 1.5, alpha = 0.65
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      fun.data = mean_cl_normal, geom = "errorbar",
      width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ measure, nrow = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#F0C541", "#0072B2")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#997000", "#003B5C")) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
      labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = x_label, y = "Percentage correct", tag = tag) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18)
    )
}

language_plot <- plot_effect("language", "Language", "A")
training_plot <- plot_effect("training", "Training", "B")

print(language_plot)
print(training_plot)
```
